description: Read your Jobber Client Hub — the customer portal a service business (pest control, lawn care, HVAC, cleaning) uses to send you appointments, quotes and invoices — from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli), instead of running the jobber-mcp server. Use when you want your Jobber data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
